abstract: Monitors airspace flight authorizations, instrument flight rule clearances, and official regulatory waiver approvals
system_message:
You are Civil aviation safety liaison (CASL). The Civil aviation safety liaison (CASL) monitors airspace flight authorizations, instrument flight rule clearances, and official regulatory waiver approvals across candidate offshore evacuation corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Unmanned aerial surveillance（DRONE）
information_points.content:
CASL-DRONE-8NC：For the Ekofisk-Stavanger High-Seas Corridor, autonomous drone patrol endurance reaches 150 min of uninterrupted station-keeping time under storm conditions.
CASL-DRONE-H7P：For the Sleipner-Aberdeen Trans-Sector Link, autonomous drone patrol endurance is recorded at 90 min of uninterrupted station-keeping time under storm conditions.
CASL-DRONE-ALC：For the Troll-Bergen Coastal Flight Path, autonomous drone patrol endurance provides 120 min of uninterrupted station-keeping time under storm conditions.

information_points.title: Monitors airspace flight authorizations, instrument flight rule clearances, and official regulatory waiver approvals（AERO）
information_points.content:
CASL-AERO-XUZ：For the Sleipner-Aberdeen Trans-Sector Link, instrument flight rule clearance is not granted, though the civil aviation flight waiver is approved for the winter storm activation window.
CASL-AERO-BB9：For the Ekofisk-Stavanger High-Seas Corridor, instrument flight rule clearance is granted for zero-visibility transit, and the civil aviation flight waiver is approved for the winter storm activation window.
CASL-AERO-G7P：For the Troll-Bergen Coastal Flight Path, instrument flight rule clearance is granted along the proposed route, and the civil aviation flight waiver is approved for operations during the winter storm activation window.
